scope: Whole-game Trial by Puffer rework. Reuses the 648 curated source-linked multiple-choice questions; adds eight stable explicit escape membership sets for 40 total.
gameplayChanges: Poison is committed before defendants drink; other witnesses predict a victim.
Dice become server-rolled push-your-luck runs: reach eight, bank, or risk another roll; a one busts.
Memory length scales from four to six pieces.
Finale requires an explicit yes/no judgment for each visible item.
All-sealed interactive stages resolve after a short synchronized countdown.
